notes.title: Corebreaker Coming to Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Corebreaker will participate in the Steam Next Fest starting February 24, 2025.

From February 24 to March 3, 2025, a time-limited demo version will be available for free download.

Corebreaker is a fast-paced 2D action-shooting roguelite game. You play as Nova, a robot awakened after humanity's extinction by machines, who must break through heavily guarded underground ruins using agile movements and powerful firearms to reach the core.

▼Demo Contents
[list]
[*] First stage of the main game
[*] Multiple weapons including Shotgun, Machine Gun, Bazooka, Plasma
[*] Various upgrade items and enhancement paths
[/list]

※ The full version will include more enemies, weapons, and upgrades

If you enjoy the demo, please add the game to your wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2190920/_/

Thank you in advance for your support!
